1327: $$
1328: \{ \sigma_w: w \in W^J \}

1330:   = \{s_\lambda: \lambda \subseteq (n-r)^r \}.

claims.text: Therefore \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) is a free abelian group with basis \(\{\bar s_\lambda:\lambda\subseteq(n-r)^r\}\): quotient the direct Schur decomposition of \(\Lambda\) by the direct summand spanned by the out-of-box Schur functions. The source’s ideal statement makes this a quotient-ring basis. [source-2@L1318-L1324|claim=formal-document]
